The Speed Ladder

Every commission is quoted at all four speeds — you choose what the moment calls for. The craft never changes; only the calendar does.

FrameExpress Now

What We Frame · Inside the Studio

One studio, every kind of keepsake

If it matters to you, it deserves conservation glass, an archival mat, and a corner joined by hand — all designed right here on 7th Street.

No. 1

Custom Framing

Art, photographs, prints, canvas and textiles — designed at the counter among thousands of corner samples, with a framer's eye beside you.

No. 2

Gallery Wall Concierge

We visit your home or office, compose the entire wall, and deliver it hung level. The design fee is fully credited to your commission.

No. 3

The Memorabilia Studio

Jerseys, medals, diplomas, ticket stubs and heirlooms — preserved in custom shadowboxes, built to museum standard.

No. 4

Art Care & Restoration

Re-matting, conservation upgrades, canvas stretching and gentle restoration for pieces that have lived a little.
